verdict.rationale: Trello documents an official MCP server that connects it to any AI tool, so agents can read and write the cards that hold work context. It also documents an Inbox that captures details from email and Slack, plus a Jira list view, card mirroring and app integrations, which give work a shared place to move between tools. None of the evidence shows handoffs between tools or agents actually preserving full context, and the MCP mention is a one-line claim without depth. Missing for 10: documented context-preserving agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff semantics, detail on what the MCP server exposes, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
